paper_id: Model-based approaches for interoperability of next generation enterprise information systems_ state of the art and future challenges
title: Model-based approaches for interoperability of next generation enterprise information systems: state of the art and future challenges
venue: Enterprise Modelling and Information Systems Architectures
motivation: 企业信息系统缺乏互操作性,阻碍竞争力提升
problem_framing: 水平(企业间)和垂直(业务-IT)互操作性障碍
key_insight: 用无歧义的形式化或半形式化模型作为互操作基础
method_signature: 模型驱动概念框架:语义对齐-转换-发现-社交网络-仿真指标
evaluation_criteria: 模型匹配质量/仿真验证指标/跨行业认可度量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 完全自动化模型发现未达,动态行为捕获困难,目前仍为开放问题

completely automated models discovery for existing systems is not reached yet
the dynamic of the system that is still difficult to capture

thinking_moves: 重构互操作问题为语义对齐问题
